events.title: Leaderboards: First Version Now Available
events.summary: The first version of Steam Leaderboards is now in Music Manager. You can compare a range of records covering songs, albums, gigs, acts and your career as a manager. This is an early version, nowhere near finished. I wanted to get the basic functionality into your hands and check that it doesn't cause problems elsewhere in the game. events.title: Playtest ending 18 October: Thank you!
events.summary: # Music Manager Playtest Ending 18th October: Thank You! After several months, countless updates and an incredible amount of feedback, the Music Manager playtest will be ending on Sunday 18th October, just a few weeks before our planned launch on 9th November. Before anything else, an enormous THANK YOU to everyone who has taken part! events.title: Playtest 3 is now fully live!
events.summary: Playtest 3 is now fully live and will run for two weeks. The game will be updated frequently as feedback is received.

events.title: Final Playtest Begins 31 July
events.summary: The previous Music Manager Playtest ended on 10 July and I have been busy working through the feedback since then. I am now planning to launch the third and final Playtest on 31 July. A COMPLETE LOCALISATION OVERHAUL The weakest area of the previous Playtest was the localised translations. Localisation support was introduced during the Playtest and I kept patching it as problems appeared, but the underlying system was flawed. events.title: Playtest - 2 days remaining!
events.summary: The second playtest is nearly over after two weeks online.Thank you to everyone who has submitted bug reports and feedback. I’ve acted on everything received, although two messages arrived slightly garbled because they were sent before the diagnostic system was updated.If you still run into any issues, please get in touch again and I’ll fix them.If you haven’t tried the playtest yet and would like to, now is the time. There are only two days remaining.

events.title: Genesis Untitled
events.summary: First, thank you to the player who reported this. Someone made a mod called genesis using the editor, which is genuinely impressive because I did not think anyone would be that deep into it yet.For some reason, there was a genre mismatch in the mod data, which meant the game could not generate song titles for new songs. events.title: Summer's here - let's talk about Christmas?
events.summary: Summer is here, so naturally it is time to talk about Christmas. A lot has changed since the last Steam update, much of it shaped directly by Playtest feedback.The biggest change is the guided tour. It was useful, but at around 120 steps it was also a bit daunting. It has now been compressed to around 45 steps with the help of some entirely sensible magical teleportation and time travel. events.title: Playtest Signups Active – Request Access Before Friday
events.summary: The first Music Manager Playtest window will open this Friday at 14:00 BST and run until Monday at 06:00 BST.An initial limited batch of testers will be admitted shortly before the playtest begins. Visit the Steam page and click Request Access before 14:00 BST on Friday to be considered for this round. Sign up before Friday to avoid getting caught out by time zones (there is no penalty for signing up early)! Further rounds will take place during the summer.
